HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0006.title: Make TV app transitions smooth

statement.en: Ensure a smooth transition from the TV app into playback.
statement.ja: TV appからplaybackへのtransitionを滑らかにする。

conditions: Present black immediately before the video becomes available to avoid flashing unrelated interface content.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0006.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit ensure directive and recorded the documented black transition.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0007.title: Show TV app content immediately

statement.en: Show the content people selected in the TV app immediately.
statement.ja: TV appで選択されたcontentを即時表示する。

conditions: Avoid opening on a splash screen, detail view, intro animation, or unrelated content.
exceptions: If a rare required interstitial appears, make its skip behavior clear and return promptly to the selected content.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0007.review_note: Recorded direct entry to selected content and preserved the narrow interstitial exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0008.title: Avoid a resume-playback prompt

statement.en: Avoid asking whether to resume playback when a valid prior position exists.
statement.ja: 有効な以前の位置がある場合、resumeするかを尋ねない。

conditions: Resume automatically at the appropriate saved position.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0008.review_note: Recorded automatic resume as the documented alternative to an unnecessary prompt.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0009.title: Play content for the correct viewer

statement.en: Make sure TV app content plays for the correct viewer profile.
statement.ja: TV app contentを正しいviewer profileで再生する。

conditions: Use the profile associated with the selected content when possible.
Switch to that profile or ask for a choice when no reliable association exists.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0009.review_note: Retained MUST from make sure and recorded selection, switching, and no-profile behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0010.title: Resume long video from its prior end time

statement.en: Use the previous end time when resuming a long video clip.
statement.ja: 長いvideo clipをresumeするとき以前のend timeを使う。

conditions: Apply this to content where restarting would lose meaningful viewing progress.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0010.review_note: Recorded the long-content condition without turning the duration description into a fixed threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0011.title: Avoid unnecessary playback loading screens

statement.en: Avoid showing a loading screen when playback can begin quickly.
statement.ja: playbackをすぐ開始できる場合はloading screenを表示しない。

exceptions: If loading exceeds about two seconds, show a black screen with a centered spinner and no other content.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0011.review_note: Preserved the quick-load default and the approximate two-second fallback rather than making it universal.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0012.title: Minimize playback loading-screen content

statement.en: Minimize content on a playback loading screen.
statement.ja: playback loading screen上のcontentを最小限にする。

conditions: Use a black background and keep branding minimal so the transition remains focused on playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0012.review_note: Recorded the black background and minimal-branding treatment.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0013.title: Exit playback to relevant content

statement.en: After playback exits, show a contextually relevant screen.
statement.ja: playback終了後はcontextに関連するscreenを表示する。

conditions: Prefer a detail view that supports resuming or choosing related content.
exceptions: Use the app's main menu when no more specific destination is meaningful.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0013.review_note: Recorded the detail-and-resume destination and main-menu fallback.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0014.title: Prepare the playback exit destination immediately

statement.en: Prepare the post-playback view as soon as an exit notification arrives.
statement.ja: exit notificationを受けたらpost-playback viewをすぐ準備する。

conditions: The destination needs to be ready even when playback exits immediately.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0014.review_note: Recorded notification timing and the immediate-exit readiness requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0016.title: Present interactive tvOS overlays gracefully

statement.en: Present interactive tvOS overlays without surprising or trapping viewers.
statement.ja: 利用者を驚かせたり閉じ込めたりせずinteractive tvOS overlayを表示する。

conditions: Delay presentation or pause playback for at least about half a second before interaction.
Provide clear ways to dismiss the overlay and resume playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0016.review_note: Recorded the approximate half-second interaction guard and both recovery actions.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0018.title: Avoid immersive visionOS autoplay

statement.en: Avoid automatically starting fully immersive visionOS video playback.
statement.ja: fully immersiveなvisionOS video playbackを自動開始しない。

conditions: Let people choose when to enter the immersive playback experience.
exceptions: Do not rely on a warning alone to replace deliberate start control.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0018.review_note: Recorded user-controlled entry and the inadequacy of warning-only autoplay.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0019.title: Provide visionOS scrubbing thumbnails

statement.en: Create a thumbnail track when supporting visionOS video scrubbing.
statement.ja: visionOS videoのscrubbingに対応するときthumbnail trackを作成する。

conditions: Use thumbnails around 160 pixels wide to balance clarity and resource cost.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0019.review_note: Recorded the conditional scrubbing scope and approximate thumbnail width.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0021.title: Use RealityKit for special-purpose visionOS video

statement.en: Use a RealityKit video player for splash, transitional, or special-effect video.
statement.ja: splash、transition、special effect用videoにはRealityKit video playerを使う。

conditions: Use this approach when transport controls and system-player integration are unnecessary.
Preserve the source aspect ratio for 2D or 3D content and provide captions where needed.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0021.review_note: Repaired the truncated title and recorded control, integration, aspect-ratio, dimensional, and caption constraints.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0022.title: Keep watchOS video clips short

statement.en: Keep watchOS video clips short.
statement.ja: watchOS video clipを短く保つ。

conditions: Prefer clips of about 30 seconds or less to limit wrist fatigue and storage cost.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0022.review_note: Kept the guidance at SHOULD and preserved 30 seconds as a preference, not a universal hard maximum.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0023.title: Use recommended watchOS video encoding values

statement.en: Use the recommended sizes and encoding values for watchOS media assets.
statement.ja: watchOS media assetには推奨sizeとencoding valueを使う。

conditions: Use H.264 High Profile video at about 160 kbps and up to 30 fps.
Use 208×260 for full-screen portrait or 320×180 for 16:9 landscape video.
Use HE-AAC audio at about 64 kbps.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0023.review_note: Preserved every value in the structured watchOS media table and kept them scoped to watchOS assets.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0024.title: Avoid control-like watchOS poster images

statement.en: Avoid making a watchOS poster image look like a system control.
statement.ja: watchOS poster imageをsystem controlのように見せない。

conditions: Prevent a static poster from implying an unavailable or different interaction.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0024.review_note: Recorded the control-affordance confusion behind the prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0026.title: Consider useful tvOS transport controls or information tabs

statement.en: Consider a tvOS transport control or custom information tab when playback-specific access is useful.
statement.ja: playback固有のaccessが有用な場合、tvOS transport controlまたはcustom information tabを検討する。

conditions: Use transport controls for playback actions and custom tabs for succinct content-specific information.
Include only options that are useful in the current viewing context.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0026.review_note: Repaired the truncated title and preserved optionality, component roles, usefulness, and succinctness.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0029.title: Avoid obscuring video with additional information

statement.en: Avoid letting additional information obscure video playback.
statement.ja: 追加informationでvideo playbackを隠さない。

conditions: Keep supplementary content placed and timed so the video remains understandable.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0029.review_note: Recovered the explicit visibility constraint separately from the optional value test.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0030.title: Keep tvOS transport actions within one or two steps

statement.en: Make sure tvOS transport actions take no more than one or two steps.
statement.ja: tvOS transport actionを1〜2手以内で完了できるようにする。

conditions: Apply the limit to actions exposed through playback transport controls.
Keep any associated custom information concise and relevant.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0030.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure directive and its one-or-two-step ceiling.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0031.title: Map Space to play and pause

statement.en: Use Space on a connected Bluetooth keyboard to play or pause playback.
statement.ja: 接続Bluetooth keyboardのSpaceでplaybackをplayまたはpauseする。

conditions: Support the mapping when a Bluetooth keyboard controls TV app playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0031.review_note: Recovered the concrete keyboard mapping from supporting prose.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0032.title: Begin playback once enough content loads

statement.en: Begin playback as soon as enough content has loaded.
statement.ja: 十分なcontentがloadされたらすぐplaybackを開始する。

conditions: Do not wait for the remaining TV app content to finish loading before playback begins.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0032.review_note: Recovered the actual readiness condition instead of retaining the vague immediate-playback fragment.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0034.title: Let people start visionOS video deliberately

statement.en: Let people choose when to start visionOS video playback.
statement.ja: visionOS video playbackの開始時点を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Preserve user control before playback changes attention or immersion.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0034.review_note: Recovered the first comfort technique at SHOULD without raising it to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0037.title: Avoid obscuring immersive playback controls

statement.en: Avoid virtual content obscuring immersive video or its transport controls.
statement.ja: virtual contentでimmersive videoまたはtransport controlを隠さない。

conditions: Apply this in a fully immersive playback experience.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0037.review_note: Recovered the conditional control-visibility prohibition at conservative AVOID strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0040.title: Keep loading TV app content in the background

statement.en: Keep loading remaining TV app content in the background after playback begins.
statement.ja: playback開始後も残りのTV app contentをbackgroundでloadし続ける。

conditions: Start playback once enough content is ready and continue fetching the rest without interrupting it.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0040.review_note: Recovered the background continuation separately from the playback-readiness rule.

prior_batch_metadata.review_method: Rendered Apple HIG Playing video guidance, supporting prose, platform sections, and the watchOS media table were reviewed; two repeated live renders matched the updated stored main-content hash.
prior_batch_metadata.review_note: Reviewed system-player defaults, aspect handling, transport behavior, TV app transitions, loading and exit states, overlays, visionOS comfort, and watchOS media constraints; recovered fourteen atomic rules and refreshed a changed page hash.

review_method: Root reviewed overview, Best practices, TV app integration, loading, exit states, resources, and all proposed corrections. One helper independently reviewed18 platform-section rules against the same official page. Matching hashes are presence evidence, not automatic semantic approval.
unverified: The source gives a minimum0.5-second interactive-overlay delay without an unambiguous reference event; no additional guaranteed timeline was inferred.
The pre-existing TV app integration scope remains tvOS; availability on other Apple platforms is not established here.
Exact old full-page prose diff cannot be reconstructed. Media demos, image pixels, linked API pages, and unrelated HIG pages were not reviewed.

ci_verification.note: Repeated after the final source-fidelity refinement of rule0018.

extraction_verification.method: Final source-fidelity refinement included in isolated re-extraction; every canonical rule file and stable-ID registry matches the working tree byte-for-byte.

final_source_clarification: The full paragraph mentions unexpected fully immersive entry without warning, but warning-alone insufficiency is an interpretation. Final conditions retain explicit user control and avoidance of unexpected entry without asserting an extra prohibition.
